name: meltemi-diagrams
description: Diagrams as code for coding agents: write, validate and export Meltemi diagrams (flow sheets, sequence diagrams, C4 models, free compositions and whiteboards, and gantt charts) as reviewable .meltemi text that opens on a canvas. Imports Mermaid and PlantUML; exports SVG, PNG, PDF and an HTML player. Teaches the agent to choose the profile, keep a sheet readable and look at the picture before delivering.
